title: Hepatitis B surface antigen in paid and volunteer blood, early 1970s
description: Bar chart. Units found reactive for hepatitis B surface antigen per 1,000 tested: about 14.1 of 48,502 units from paid donors (685 reactive) and 2.2 of 83,196 units from volunteer donors (182 reactive). Data: Food and Drug Administration, proposed rule, Federal Register 40 (14 November 1975): 53040–41; rates by our arithmetic.
heading: HBsAg-REACTIVE UNITS PER 1,000 TESTED
